# JS reference fixtures

Some fixtures are generated by running the official Inngest JS SDK's
TypeScript sources directly with Node 24, so PHP output can be compared
byte-for-byte with real JS output.

`register.mjs` / `version-hook.mjs` let Node load the sources without a
build: they supply the generated `src/version.ts` and map `./x.js` and
extensionless imports onto `.ts` files.

Run a generator from the JS package directory, e.g.:

```bash
cd /path/to/inngest-js/packages/inngest
node --import /path/to/tests/fixtures/js/register.mjs \
     --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings \
     /path/to/tests/fixtures/functions/generate.mts "$PWD" \
     > /path/to/tests/fixtures/functions/js-configs.json
```

Generated against inngest-js `packages/inngest` v4.26.0 (commit
`4c4e4e43`).
